'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Arab–Israeli conflict]]
**[[2024 Tel Aviv truck attack]]
***A man is killed and thirty others are injured in a [[vehicle-ramming attack]] when an [[Arab citizens of Israel|Arab Israeli]] man rams his truck into a bus stop north of [[Tel Aviv]], [[Israel]], before being fatally shot by an armed civilian. Authorities are investigating the incident as a suspected [[terrorist]] attack. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdj33rwlyepo (BBC News)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Egypt]]ian [[President of Egypt|President]] [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]] proposes a temporary two-day [[ceasefire]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] to [[prisoner exchange|exchange]] four [[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis|Israeli hostages]] for several [[Palestinians in Israeli custody|Palestinian prisoners]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strikes-kill-dozens-north-gaza-raid-deepens-medics-say-2024-10-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese Civil War]]
**[[2024 eastern Gezira State massacres]]
***The [[United Nations]] condemns the [[Rapid Support Forces]]' targeted [[mass killing]] of [[civilian]]s in [[Gezira State]], [[Sudan]], comparing it to earlier mass killings in [[Darfur]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8rll0xv8gko (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Bolivian protest]]
**Former [[Bolivia]]n [[President of Bolivia|president]] [[Evo Morales]] claims that he survived an [[assassination]] attempt. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivias-morales-says-vehicle-fired-upon-amid-rising-political-tension-2024-10-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**At least 40 [[Chad National Army|Chadian soldiers]] are killed during a [[mass shooting]] by [[Boko Haram]] gunmen against a military base near [[Ngouboua]], [[Chad]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20241028-jihadist-attack-near-lake-chad-leaves-40-dead-president-orders-retaliation (Rfi)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Pacific typhoon season]]
**The death toll from [[Tropical Storm Trami (2024)|Tropical Storm Trami]] in the [[Philippines]] increases to 136 people killed and missing. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/27/floods-and-landslides-in-philippines-leave-at-least-136-dead-or-missing (Al Jazeera)]
* A man steals an SUV and [[Vehicle-ramming attack|rams]] passers-by and a group of protesters from the [[National Front for the Family]], in front of [[Guadalajara Cathedral]], causing 16 injuries. The authorities are still investigating the incident to determine the motivations and circumstances of the attack.[https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2024/10/29/estados/imputan-a-conductor-que-atropello-a-manifestantes-en-guadalajara-2071 (La Jornada)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Japanese general election]]
**[[Japan|Japanese]] citizens vote for the 465 seats in the [[House of Representatives (Japan)|House of Representatives]]. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20241027_z01/ (NHK)]
**The ruling coalition of the [[Liberal Democratic Party (Japan)|Liberal Democratic Party]] and [[Komeito]] loses its majority. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/japan-votes-election-expected-punish-pm-ishibas-coalition-2024-10-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Georgian parliamentary election]]
**[[President of Georgia]] [[Salome Zourabichvili]] announces that she does not recognize the official results of the election, alleging that [[Georgia (country)|the country]] has been the victim of a "[[Russia]]n special operation". [https://www.rferl.org/a/georgia-parliamentary-vote-violence-intimidation-russia-west/33175194.html (Radio Free Europe)] [https://civil.ge/archives/631657 (Civil.ge)]
*[[2024 Liechtenstein referendums#27 October|2024 Liechtenstein referendums]]
**Voters in [[Liechtenstein]] approve a referendum to [[Privatization|privatize]] [[Radio Liechtenstein]], the country's state-owned [[radio station]]. [https://apnews.com/article/liechtenstein-radio-funding-referendum-b295cb13ae8f6f0543d52528ea2320ed (AP)]
*[[2024 Lithuanian parliamentary election]]
**The [[Social Democratic Party of Lithuania]] wins 52 seats in the [[Seimas]] election, forming a [[majority government|majority]] with its coalition partners [[Union of Democrats "For Lithuania"|"For Lithuania"]] and the [[Lithuanian Farmers and Greens Union|Farmers and Greens Union]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/lithuania-opposition-social-democrats-win-election/a-70611400 (DW)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/lithuania-opposition-seeks-cement-election-win-run-off-votes-2024-10-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Uruguayan general election]]
**[[Uruguay|Uruguayan]] citizens vote for a [[President of Uruguay|President]] in the first round of the general election. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/uruguays-moderate-election-race-bucks-trend-regional-political-divides-2024-10-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[October 2024 Bulgarian parliamentary election]]
**[[Bulgaria]]n citizens vote for a new [[National Assembly (Bulgaria)|National Assembly]] in the country's seventh election in the past four years. [https://www.euronews.com/2024/10/26/bulgarians-head-to-the-polls-to-vote-in-seventh-general-election-in-three-years (Euronews)]
